title: I built and released my first top-down racing game using AI as a development partner
author: dJ1fRee
selftext:
After months of development, I’ve just released **Top Down RACE** on Android.  
One of the most interesting parts of the project has been how I used generative AI throughout development. I’m an independent developer, and AI became a development assistant rather than something that simply generated the finished game for me.  
I used it to help write and review code, debug problems, document the project, analyse bugs reported by testers and iterate on features. A lot of the work still involved testing everything on real devices, identifying what wasn’t working, changing it and testing again. Some problems took many iterations before we found the actual cause.  
That workflow eventually helped me take the project from an idea to a published Android game with car progression, multiple circuits, global leaderboards and asynchronous ghost racing.  
I’m curious how other indie developers using AI work: **do you find AI more useful for creating new code, or for debugging and iterating on code you already have?**  
The game is free on Google Play:  
[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.craftracestudio.topdownrace](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.craftracestudio.topdownrace)

comments.author: Wooden_Plant7504
comments.body: Reminds me of the amiga game "supercars"

replies.author: dJ1fRee
replies.body: **Yes! I’m actually from that era 😄 I grew up with games like Super Cars, so that classic top-down racing DNA is definitely part of my inspiration. With TDR I wanted to bring that feeling into a more modern mobile game, with progression, online leaderboards and ghost racing. Thanks for checking it out! 🏁**

replies.author: Wooden_Plant7504
replies.body: Looks well done. If it ever gets pushed to iOS and Testflight I'd be down to try it.

replies.author: dJ1fRee
replies.body: **Thanks! 😄 An iOS version is actually planned, and TestFlight will be part of the testing process. I’ll definitely keep you in mind when it’s ready — would be great to have you testing it! 🏁**
